spans.text: On the way to the mission objective.
...It just feels weird.
You've held it in for half the trip already, did you really have to bring it up now?
But it DOES feel weird.
Why do we have to work with S.F.?
Is there no other way to catch Gager?
Don't you think it's fun? This is my first time working with S.F. on a mission from the Commander. It's kinda fresh!
Ah, while the lot of you seem really put upon because of me...
Don't you think I'm the one who's in the most danger here?!
I only held back in the office because the Commander stopped me.
But since we're outside now, if you do anything you shouldn't, then I'll... hehehehehehe~
Eeeeep!
Are you SURE you told her I'm not an enemy anymore?!
The Commander only said we were to use you as bait to capture Gager. I didn't hear anything about bringing you back.
So...you catch my drift?
Ahhhh! I'm going to jump off the chopper! Right now!
Alright, that's enough. Since the Commander gave such an order, there must be a good reason for it.
All we need to do is carry it out.
It's not like I'm doubting the Commander either...
It's just that I don't understand WHY we have to do this.
Oh? Well, about that.
It's fairly straightforward.
I volunteered for the mission.
...You volunteered?
Is it that strange?
I heard that my lady knight was in trouble.
Plus, this was my former turf.
Since everything added up, your Commander had no reason to refuse me.
Oh, you want reasons? I've got a whole bunch of them.
Let's start with the simplest one - "trust".
But the Commander didn't say no.
Maybe your Commander trusts me over you?
I'm not interested in your crude provocations.
But if SOP-II gets mad, she might end up doing things to you, so you'd best watch your words.
Erm...er... Then pretend I never said anything.
Also... The Commander has definitely thought this through.
Our intel only mentioned that Gager MIGHT be in the area, but that info isn't verified.
However, if we bring her along, I'm sure Gager won't be able to restrain herself and show up.
Assuming she's actually there, of course.
Now isn't that a simple and direct mission plan? The hook is straight and even the bait is nice and fragrant.
You'd best be as obedient as you say you are.
Relax, all I want is to take a look around the place after spending so long away from it.
If I were so loyal to S.F., surely I would have done something by now, don't you think?
Do I look like someone who's willing to die for the cause?
I don't care what kind of person you are.
I only trust what I can see.
Speaking of "what you can see"...
Is that a residential district up ahead?
It would seem we have arrived at the destination that the Commander gave us.
...What's this?
Is this a village?
No...
Something's not right.
Well, isn't this a slaughterhouse.
Looks like these people have been dead for a while.
No life signs detected.
...I guess something bad happened to this village. The only things still moving around here are a few ELIDs.
RO... What happened here?
You ask me, but...
This doesn't look like an ELID attack.
The corpses' dermal layers show signs of rapid silicification, probably due to Collapse radiation exposure.
But radiation levels here are far from being lethal.
Or at least they aren't right now.
15, did you find anything?
Nothing out of the ordinary... Wait a minute.
What's this?
A crate? Oooh, a special-looking crate!
It doesn't look like it came from around here.
It looks very expensive, but why would someone just dump it by the side of the road...?
Do you recognize the logo on it?
Nope, never seen it before.
I'll record it for now. We'll stick to the plan and scout the entire area before reporting back.
An hour later.
Commander, do you read me?
This is our regularly-scheduled check-in.
I copy. Any progress?
Yes, Commander.
We've finished scouting the location indicated by your coordinates.
It looks like a human settlement.
Did you find anyone suspicious?
No, everyone here is dead.
The situation here is somewhat similar to Tallinn.
Dammit...
Havier must have a reason for making us check this place. Did you find anything?
We did some initial investigations and found several strange crates.
That's...
Do you recognize them?
...No, I don't.
But the writing on them is German.
So you're saying these crates were sent here from Germany?
Dandelion, can you learn anything from them?
They simply say that they are civilian supply crates, without any other information.
By the looks of things, these containers were left here before someone opened them up and removed the contents.
What was inside them?
We can't tell from the containers, but I have the feeling that it's definitely linked to the deaths of these villagers.
I've uploaded the images, though I couldn't find anything regarding them on the Griffin servers.
However, I feel that this is enough for that gentleman to mount an investigation of his own.
I'll report the discovery of these crates to Havier.
Since the situation is similar to Tallinn, then this must have something to do with William.
Hand the crates over to the aircrew. Do a sweep of the region and look for more clues.
Understood.
But this may delay the Sangvis plant mission.
Do you wish to extend the mission duration, Commander?
No need for that.
I'll stay behind and check this place out. You guys should just stick to the plan and move on to the next objective.
I will stay and investigate with her.
The situation here somewhat bothers me.
Huh? Is this alright?
Right now, Sangvis Ferri are just a disorganized rabble. You should be enough to deal with them.
Besides, you've got a millstone around your necks too, don't you?
Everyone looks at Architect, who's spacing out while staring at the sky.
Are you sure?
You aren't armed, and your electronic hacking will be useless against the Infected.
I am fully confident in AR-15's ability to protect me.
Well, I don't want to protect you.
Also, do you even need protection?
Compared to a Doll who only knows how to shoot, it would be more efficient for me to perform intelligence-gathering tasks.
Since we've taken the trouble to come all the way here, I trust none of us wants to go back empty-handed.
What Dandelion says makes sense. There must be some clues here which we haven't discovered yet. They will be very important for future operations.
Understood. In that case, you and Dandelion should stay here and continue the investigation.
Catch up with us immediately once you're done.
Looks like we have our orders.
...Acknowledged.
